description: Audit one public URL or site origin and return findings that each carry a concrete fix. focus=full (default) runs the public one-page scan (20+ checks: meta, canonical, robots, sitemap, llms.txt, schema, hreflang, redirects, agent discovery) and returns a grade, every failing/warning finding and a seven-day report URL; it consumes one free scan (3/day/IP). focus=signals checks canonical, noindex, meta, hreflang and structured data; focus=agent runs up to eight agent-readiness probes with a 0–100 score; focus=mcp checks the MCP server card, OAuth discovery, auth.md and the A2A card; focus=robots, sitemap and llms run only that single check. The focused modes do not consume the scan quota. Pass updateId (full) to attach a public radar update's checks, and compareTo with a previous scanId (full) to get added, resolved and persisting findings plus the score delta. Use this instead of asking the user to run several separate checks.

checks.description: focus=agent only: optional readiness probe ids (default: the eight cheap probes).

compareTo.description: focus=full only: scanId from a previous full audit of the same URL. Adds compare.added/resolved/persisting and scoreDelta.

focus.description: full = complete page scan (scan quota); signals = five page signals; agent = up to eight readiness probes; mcp = MCP/OAuth discovery; robots, sitemap, llms = one focused check. Default full.

includeFull.description: focus=llms only: also probe /llms-full.txt (adds one network request).

updateId.description: focus=full only: public radar update id or slug to attach its checks (optional).

url.description: Public http(s) URL or site origin

name: visdenda_audit_site
title: Audit a page or site
